source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The migration's weekday map has numeric keys 1–7, while positional BYDAY values also encode an ordinal. Its original monthly branch uses the raw value as the key; for example 10 means position 1/weekday 2 and cannot match that map. Fixed accepted code decodes through day_of_week before lookup. Keep this original bug and later correction separate from the locale migration's broader claims. This is a static key/producer mismatch, with no rendered recurrence result or all-locale test.
title: Decode positional BYDAY values before looking up Calendar weekday names
